evidence.quote: class fund $36,000,000; attorneys' fees $2,000,000; clear sailing no
We can reduce our proposed fee request to $2 million if Brightline increases the class fund to $37 million.
Fees were included in our initial proposal; they were not first discussed after class relief was agreed.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fee terms in their opening public term sheets, before class relief was settled. Whitcombe expressly linked a reduced fee request to a higher class fund. The transcript does not clearly show class counsel prioritizing firm economics, defense exploiting fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
